log.text: Read re-deriver brief and questions_operating.json: 23 questions (12 run-rate months, 10 period-revenue, 1 headcount). FY2024 (x2) and FY2025 (x2) questions have identical text.

Google News RSS discovery (3 queries): 'Anthropic annualized revenue run rate', 'Anthropic run-rate revenue billion 2026', 'Anthropic headcount employees' - surfaced Aug-Sep 2026 coverage ($65B end-July, $100B pace, S-1 leak, SaaStr '~5,000 employees').
SEC EDGAR company browse for 'anthropic' (S-1): 'No matching companies' - the draft S-1 is confidential and not on EDGAR.
SEC EDGAR full-text search 'Anthropic PBC' S-1 (1 query): only other issuers (Nscale, SpaceX, Figma, Idea Acquisition) mention Anthropic; no Anthropic registration statement indexed.
Bing RSS in web mode (2 queries): returned only anthropic.com/claude.com/Wikipedia pages, no news.

Google News article links do not resolve in WebFetch; Reuters, CNBC, Bloomberg, Forbes, Ars Technica, ZDNET, Economic Times, NY Post, Inc., Morningstar, FourWeekMBA and web.archive.org are not fetchable (blocked, 403 or empty). DuckDuckGo gave a captcha and Brave a 429. Switched to Bing News RSS (direct URLs), syndicated copies (Yahoo Finance, Investing.com) and outlets that do open.

Bing News RSS (3 queries that returned items): 'Anthropic run rate $65 billion', 'Anthropic second quarter revenue $11.5 billion', 'Anthropic confidential prospectus revenue 2025 net loss' - gave direct URLs for CNBC video, Forbes, Yahoo/Quartz, IBTimes, SiliconANGLE, Motley Fool, Benzinga, Inc., 24/7 Wall St., eWeek, eeNews.
Quartz via Yahoo (2026-09-29): Reuters - revenue nearly $4.6B in 2025, twelvefold; FT - Q2 revenue $11.5B; opex ~$13B; net loss ~$42B (about $34B non-cash).
SiliconANGLE (2026-09-29): 'revenue ballooned from $400 million in 2024 to $4.6 billion last year'; leaked filing reviewed by Reuters/FT; draft S-1 from June 2026.
IBTimes (2026-08-17): preliminary Q2 revenue more than $11.5B vs $787M a year earlier; Q1 2026 $4.73B; Anthropic said in May run rate crossed $47B.
IBTimes says 'roughly $10 billion in actual revenue during 2025', contradicting the S-1-era ~$4.59B; likely mislabels the ~$9-10B exit run-rate. Reported as a conflict, not adopted.
Benzinga via Yahoo (2026-09-30): usage revenue $3.8B + subscription $789M; cloud marketplace sales ~$2.16B = 47% of 2025 revenue; two customers 12% each.
TechCrunch (2026-09-28, Connie Loizos): revenue twelvefold to nearly $4.6B (Reuters); Q2 $11.5B and second straight adjusted operating profit (FT); no 2023 data or headcount.
24/7 Wall St. (2026-09-30): 2025 revenue $4.6B, about 12x the roughly $400M of 2024; Q1 2026 $4.73B and Q2 $11.5B.

Motley Fool (2026-09-29), eeNews Europe, eWeek, Pulse 2.0, Gizmodo prospectus write-ups (5 pages): all relay Reuters/FT (2025 revenue nearly $4.6B; op loss $8.06B vs $2.98B in 2024; 80% gross margin before distribution-partner revenue share); none has headcount or FY2023.

OfficeChai S-1 write-ups (2 pages, 2026-09-29): 2025 revenue nearly $4.6B; OpenAI accuses Anthropic of booking cloud-partner revenue gross; prospectus coverage does not clarify the method; both approaches permitted under US GAAP; run rate $47B at filing.
CryptoSlate (2026-09-29): revenue jumped 1,088% in 2025 to $4.59 billion; two largest customers 12% each.
Bitcoin.com News (2026-09-29): revenue rose from about $386 million in 2024 to $4.59 billion in 2025; 2024 operating loss $2.98B.

Exact-figure lookups (3 queries: 1 Google News, 2 Bing News) - headlines from tokenpost, TradingKey, KuCoin, Futu print $4.59B; a Bing title lookup gave the Tech Times snippet that Reuters obtained and reviewed the confidential draft on Monday 2026-09-28.

FY2024 differs slightly by vintage: $381M (The Information, Jan 2026, via Epoch) vs about $386M (S-1-era: +1,088% growth; Bitcoin.com News) vs ~$383M (flat 12x) vs ~$400M (rounded). Reported all four.

FY2025 ~ $4.6B appears in TechCrunch, SiliconANGLE, Quartz, Benzinga, Motley Fool, Pulse 2.0, eeNews, Gizmodo, eWeek, OfficeChai, 24/7 Wall St. - all relay the same Reuters/FT review of one draft S-1, so one underlying origin. Split $3.8B + $0.789B = $4.589B matches 'nearly $4.6B'.

Reuters' original prospectus story (and FT, WSJ, CNBC, Bloomberg, Forbes and Economic Times versions) could not be opened; all S-1 figures are read through outlets that relay them. Economic Times snippet gives $4.59B.
FY2025 revenue ~ $4.59B (draft S-1 via Reuters/FT, 2026-09-28/29); preliminary $4.5B from The Information in Jan 2026.
FY2025 revenue (duplicate claim id) - same answer.
FY2024 revenue ~ $386M (S-1-era: +1,088% growth / Bitcoin.com News); $381M (The Information per Epoch); ~ $400M rounded (SiliconANGLE, 24/7 Wall St.).
FY2024 revenue (duplicate claim id) - same answer.

May 2026 run-rate: $47B, company-stated 2026-05-28 ('earlier this month').

Anthropic confidential draft S-1 Rule 135 notice (2026-06-01).

Google News RSS date-bounded history batch (11 queries): Aug-Dec 2023; Oct 2023 (x2); Jan-Apr 2024; Nov 2024-Feb 2025; Jan-Feb 2025; Mar 2025; May 2025 (credit facility); May 28-Jun 12 2025 ($3B); Jun-Aug 2025; Jul 28-Sep 5 2025 - mapped The Information / Reuters / CNBC / Bloomberg run-rate reports by month (titles and dates only; links do not resolve).

Google News RSS: gross-vs-net queries (4): 'OpenAI Anthropic revenue overstated $8 billion', 'prospectus gross revenue principal agent', 'books revenue gross cloud resellers', 'gross net run-rate OpenAI overstated' - surfaced Forbes 2026-03-25 'OpenAI And Anthropic Count Revenue Differently' (403), Axios/Yahoo explainer, SemiAnalysis, techtimes 2026-06-05.

Sacra: says Anthropic books reseller (AWS/Google/Microsoft) revenue gross; no FY2022-2024 revenue; no headcount. Aggregator, lead only.

Gross-vs-net: OpenAI contends Anthropic's $30B run rate is overstated by ~$8B because cloud-partner sales are counted gross (VentureBeat); Axios/SaaStr/Sacra say Anthropic books full partner-channel value with cloud cuts as expenses; OfficeChai says the prospectus coverage does not clarify the method. I did not find the S-1 revenue-recognition wording.

PYMNTS relaying WSJ (2026-05-20): Q2 projected $10.9B, up 130% from $4.8B in Q1; expected operating income $559M.
PYMNTS relaying Bloomberg (2026-08-16): documents viewed by Bloomberg show preliminary Q2 revenue above $11.5B vs $787M a year earlier.
The Next Web (2026-08-19): WSJ says Anthropic Q2 revenue $11.6B; Bloomberg's preliminary figure was $11.5B.
Q2 2026 differs by outlet: $11.5B (Bloomberg prelim; FT S-1 review) vs $11.6B (WSJ); earlier WSJ projection $10.9B. Both reported.
Q1 2026 revenue $4.73B (Bloomberg-era docs via IBTimes; S-1-era 24/7 Wall St.); WSJ had $4.8B.

Google News RSS: FY2022/FY2023/FY2024 revenue queries (6): '2023 revenue', 'revenue in 2022', '2024 revenue $381 million/$400 million', 'revenue last year 2023' (2024), 'S-1 2023', 'Jan-Feb 2026 2025 revenue $4.5B' - nothing reports FY2022 or FY2023; FY2024 $381M only via the Epoch index.
CourtListener PDF, CFO Krishna Rao declaration (2026-03-09, N.D. Cal. 3:26-cv-01996, Doc. 6-5): revenue 'exceeding $5 billion to date'; >$60B raised; >$10B spent on training/inference; no headcount.
Cumulative cross-check: CFO sworn '>$5B to date' (2026-03-09) vs FY2024 ~ $0.38B + FY2025 ~ $4.59B = ~ $4.97B, so FY2023 must be small if 'to date' ran through end-2025. Inference only.
FY2022: no figure published; Series G says first dollar of revenue earned less than three years before 2026-02-12, implying $0 in 2022 (inference).
FY2023 revenue: nothing found from company, S-1 coverage or investor documents (coverage compares only 2024 vs 2025). UNTRACEABLE.
FY2023 revenue: no company, S-1-coverage or investor-document figure found. Reported as UNTRACEABLE rather than estimated.

Google News RSS + Bing News headcount queries (12 in total): 'headcount employees 2026 workforce hiring', 'prospectus employees as of full-time', 'S-1 takeaways employees', 'Anthropic, which employs', 'employees 4,000/5,000/3,000', 'revenue per employee', 'number of employees', 'takes over entire office building', 'leases NY office', 'prospectus employees' - surfaced SaaStr, SFist/SF Chronicle lease stories, NY Post lease story, Fortune Dec 2025 (not openable).

WebSearch 3/4: 'Anthropic hits $3 billion in annualized revenue ... Reuters May 30 2025' - gave the Yahoo copy of the Reuters exclusive and Sacra.

Revelio Labs employees page: ~3,950 (Mar 2026); 2023 546, 2024 1,324, 2025 3,089 (page says published Aug 2026).
Tracxn and TrueUp pages returned HTTP 403; Tracxn 5,994 (2026-08-31) is a WebSearch snippet only, unverified on the page.

SaaStr headcount piece (2026-04-14): 3,000-5,000 depending on source (Tracxn ~5,000 Mar 2026, TrueUp ~3,000, PitchBook and Gerstner ~2,500); Gerstner run-rate points $1B end-2024, $4B mid-2025, $9B end-2025, $30B end-March 2026.
Wikipedia infobox reference trace: 2,500 employees (2026) cites SF Chronicle 2026-01-30 (Laura Waxmann).
SFist (2026-01-30): 'Anthropic, which currently has 2,500 employees worldwide and 1,300 locally'; 1,300+ Bay Area attributed to Daniela Amodei.
Fortune via Yahoo (2026-08-25, Preston Fore): refers to the AI company's 'more than 2,500 employees' - latest named-outlet headcount.
anthropic.com/company: no employee count.
JobsByCulture blog: ~500 (2023) to ~2,300+ (Q4 2025, citing Fortune). T4, Fortune page itself not opened (guessed URLs 404).
SiliconANGLE (2025-09-26): company to triple headcount outside US (no baseline total).
Reuters factbox on S-1 executives/board (kfgo.com copy), Investing.com explainer, Forge IPO page, Gradually explainer (4 pages): no headcount or FY2023 data.

Headcount: no company-stated total; named outlets say ~2,500 (SF Chronicle Jan 2026) and more than 2,500 (Fortune Aug 2026); vendors say ~3,950 (Revelio Mar 2026) to ~5,000-5,994 (Tracxn Mar-Aug 2026); Revelio trajectory 546 / 1,324 / 3,089 / 3,950.
Headcount: no company figure; named outlets (2,500 / more than 2,500) sit well below vendor counts (Revelio 3,950, Tracxn ~5,000-5,994); up to 2.4x spread.

Consistency: Q2 2026 recognized revenue $11.5B annualizes to ~$46B, in line with the company run-rate path ($30B Apr, $47B May, $65B end-July); Q2 2025 $787M annualizes to ~$3.1B, in line with the $3B run rate at end-May 2025. Axios/NYT (2026-09-18) 'up 50% from two months ago' to >$100B implies ~$65-67B in July, consistent with $65B.

Note: Q1 2026 recognized revenue $4.73B annualizes to ~$18.9B, above the average Q1 run rate implied by $14B (Feb) and $19B (Mar) - recognized and run-rate measures are not interchangeable; both are gross of cloud-partner cuts.

Run-rate chain is internally consistent: $1B (Dec 2024) -> $2B (Mar 2025) -> $3B (May) -> $4-5B (Jul) -> >$5B (Aug) -> $7B (Oct) -> ~$9B (Dec) -> $14B (Feb 2026) -> $19B (Mar) -> $30B (Apr) -> $47B (May) -> $65B (end-Jul); recognized revenue (FY2025 $4.59B, Q1 2026 $4.73B, Q2 2026 $11.5B) is far below the run rates, as expected for an annualized exit rate.

Gross-vs-net: Axios (2026-09-03), SaaStr, Sacra and the Motley Fool (80% gross margin before distribution-partner revenue share) agree Anthropic books full partner-channel value with the cloud cut as an expense; OpenAI's claim of ~$8B overstatement is relayed only by VentureBeat. I did not find the S-1 revenue-recognition wording itself.

Hand-off to orchestrator: 23 questions answered. Key points: run-rate months are mostly company-stated (Anthropic posts for Sep 2025, Oct 2025, Feb/Apr/May 2026); FY2023 untraceable; FY2022 only inferable as $0; headcount has no company figure and third-party counts conflict 2,500 to ~6,000; H1 and TTM are derived, not reported. All revenue is reported gross of cloud-partner cuts (run-rate and recognized); the S-1 method wording itself was not located.
